They define a real process on Z, finite second moments, constant mean, and γ(h)=Cov(X_{t+h},X_t), independent of t. The current draft theorem thm-sample-acvf-properties-and-summable-covariance-mean-consistency was also read; this pair does not use a CLT or ergodic conclusion from it. Batch 40's carriers remain draft; this is an interface check, not independent approval.

The published thm-bochner-theorem-for-lca-groups statement and proof were inspected. It represents a continuous positive-definite function on an LCA group by a unique finite positive Radon measure on the dual and explicitly assumes both AC and DC. The discrete-Z dual identification gives characters e^{ihλ}; the spectral-measure existence theorem carries both axioms.
